response.title: which solar generators that came out in 2026 are worth buying over older models
response.answer:
The solar generators worth buying in 2026 aren't necessarily the ones with the largest batteries. The biggest reasons to choose a new model over a discounted 2024–2025 model are:

Better value per kWh: More usable battery capacity for the same price.

Faster solar charging: Higher solar input limits, especially useful for off-grid use.

Improved home backup: Better UPS functionality, higher output, and easier integration with home circuits.

Portability: More capacity without substantially increasing weight.

Long-term expandability: Additional batteries, smarter energy management, and better warranty support.

One important distinction: a solar generator is typically a battery power station with an inverter and solar charging capability. Solar panels are often sold separately.

My top 2026 releases worth considering

A particularly compelling 2026 upgrade for RVs, off-grid solar, and expandable backup. High-voltage solar input, native RV outlet, and individually controlled AC outlets make it more versatile than many older 2kWh units. 
PR Newswire

Around $2,500 launch price

5,024Wh · 4,500W · 120/240V

One of the most interesting new choices for home backup. Its larger base battery and 240V capability are appealing versus older 3–4kWh systems, although the older F3800 Plus delivers more continuous power.

Worth considering for high-power home backup and 240V appliances. Choose carefully among Classic, standard, and Plus versions: their output and solar capabilities differ substantially.

+1

Promising for powerful portable backup, but not an automatic upgrade. Its 1,000W solar input is a limitation relative to some competing new models. Shipping is expected in late November, so I'd wait for independent tests.
